text: Free demo: can your base survive a hundred thousand monsters at once?
You don't fight. You build a death blender.
Lasers, spikes and chain lightning grind the swarm down, and every kill pays for upgrades.
Best part: the swarm moves like a river, flowing around your walls.
The catch? The ground is flat and the monsters are tiny blobs.
The Windows demo is under two hundred megabytes, in eleven languages.
Think Vampire Survivors, if you were the tower.
Worth a dip if you like watching numbers go up.
